title: The Three Little Pigs
source: English fairy tale (Joseph Jacobs, 1890, public domain). Original retelling.
moral: Slow, careful work builds something strong.

pages.text: Once upon a time, three little pigs set off to build their own houses.
pages.caption: Three little pigs

pages.text: The first little pig found some straw. Swish, swish! A straw house, quick as a wink.
pages.caption: A house of straw

pages.text: The second little pig found some sticks. Tap, tap! A stick house, done by lunch.
pages.caption: A house of sticks

pages.text: The third little pig found some bricks. Brick by brick, slow and steady, all day long.
pages.caption: A house of bricks

pages.text: Along came a big grey wolf. He was hungry, and he was sneaky.
pages.caption: Along came a wolf

pages.text: The wolf knocked on the straw house. Knock, knock! "Little pig, let me in!"
pages.caption: Knock, knock!

pages.text: "No, no, no!" said the little pig. "Not by the hair on my chinny-chin-chin!"
pages.caption: No, no, no!

pages.text: So the wolf huffed and he puffed. Huff and puff! The straw house blew away.
pages.caption: Huff and puff!

pages.text: The first pig ran to the stick house. The wolf came too. Knock, knock!
pages.caption: Run to the sticks

pages.text: "No, no, no!" said the pigs. "Not by the hair on our chinny-chin-chins!"
pages.caption: Two pigs say no

pages.text: Huff and puff! Huff and puff! The stick house tumbled down, sticks everywhere.
pages.caption: Sticks everywhere

pages.text: Both pigs ran to the brick house. The third pig opened the door. "Come in, quick!"
pages.caption: Safe in the bricks

pages.text: The wolf huffed and puffed. He puffed and huffed. But the brick house did not move.
pages.caption: Bricks stay still

pages.text: The wolf was so puffed out, he flopped down. Then he gave up and ran away home.
pages.caption: Wolf runs home

pages.text: The three little pigs cheered. Hooray! They built two more brick houses, side by side.
pages.caption: Three brick houses

pages.text: And they lived happily, safe and snug, for ever and ever. The end.
pages.caption: Happy ever after
